newsitem.title: UK: ATHLETICS-SERBIAN STUDENTS TO JOIN BELGRADE MARATHON.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-SERBIAN STUDENTS TO JOIN BELGRADE MARATHON.

text.p: Hundreds of Serbian students, who spent four months demonstrating in Belgrade will take to the same streets on Saturday to run in the city's marathon.
The students, who marched to overthrow the city council, said they wanted to show support for the first international event to be staged under the new administration.
But they are up against tough opposition. Defending champion Ahmed Salah of Djibouti, twice winner of the World Cup Marathon, will head one of the strongest fields in 10 years of the event.
Salah will be challenged by Ethiopian Tena Negere as well as Vladimir Kotov of Belarus and a group of young Kenyan runners.
